messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity alert for service="inference-prod" — GPU queue growth + throttling detected. Check: autoscaler, metrics pipeline. Pager URL: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/1798765432 :rotating_light:

sofia-sre: i'm paged, starting triage. taking on-call. any visible customer impact?

maya-support: seeing multiple customer error spikes on gen endpoints, 429s and elevated latency (p95 ~4.2s -> 12s). Customers on Dedicated clusters affected. CC @sofia-sre

sofia-sre: noted. hypothesis: HPA didn't scale due to metrics adapter lag. will run quick checks.

sofia-sre: running `kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-gpu --watch` and `kubectl get deploy -n inference inference-runtime -o wide`

armando-runtime: adding context — we hit cluster GPU limit earlier today (reserved capacity running at 95%). autoscaler should have used fallback model variants but queue still grew.

sofia-sre: `kubectl describe hpa inference-gpu -n inference` -> shows `metrics: external/pods_gpu_utilization on prom_adapter (30s)`. Current replicas: 12, desired: 24 but HPA not scaling.

sofia-sre: checking Prometheus query used by adapter: `sum(rate(gpu_allocated_seconds_total[1m])) / count(node_gpu_total)` returns NaN for last 30s. suspicious.

lee-ml: prometheus reports a scrape gap for the gpu-exporter target. last_scrape_duration_seconds: 0.0, last_scrape_timestamp: 0.0 -> indicates target marked down.

sofia-sre: checking adapter logs: `kubectl logs -n k8s-system prom-adapter-5f6d -c adapter | tail -n 200` -> lots of `failed to query prometheus: context deadline exceeded` and `unexpected status code 503`.

armando-runtime: so adapter can't reach prometheus or prometheus overloaded. if adapter returns errors HPA treats metric as stale and won't scale. that matches observed desired>current but no scale.

sofia-sre: looking at prometheus: `kubectl get pods -n monitoring` shows `prometheus-0` OOMKilled and in CrashLoopBackOff. memory usage spiked ~15m ago.

deploy-bot: recent deploy at 1798761000 by @armando-runtime — config change `prometheus: retention: 7d -> 14d` and added additional scrape configs. could be correlated.

armando-runtime: i rolled that change earlier, but prom pods were fine for hours. possible a scrape target caused a busy query. checking slow queries: `kubectl exec -n monitoring prometheus-0 -- prometheus-query 'query=query_log_tail(100)'` (pseudo) shows heavy cardinality from model-level metrics after a rollout.

lee-ml: ML infra did a model rollout two releases ago adding per-shard metrics which increased series cardinality ~10x. that likely caused prom CPU/memory blowout when retention doubled.

sofia-sre: mitigation plan: 1) reduce prometheus retention back to 7d (quick restart), 2) scale prometheus statefulset to 2 replicas if resources allow, 3) temporarily switch HPA metric to a fallback (node GPU utilization via metrics-server) to force scaling, 4) notify customers and postmortem. executing step 1 now.

sofia-sre: `kubectl patch sts prometheus -n monitoring -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"prometheus","env":[{"name":"PROM_RETENTION","value":"168h"}]}]}}}}'` -> applied. restarting prom pod.

sofia-sre: prometheus pod restarting. monitoring adapter logs still show errors, but trying to re-register.

maya-support: posting status update to customers: "We're investigating increased errors and latency on inference-prod. Engineers are working on autoscaler and metrics. We will update in 20 minutes." :white_check_mark:

sofia-sre: step 3 (fallback metric) — patching HPA to use `external/node_gpu_utilization` via metrics-server temporarily: `kubectl patch hpa inference-gpu -n inference -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"External","external":{"metricName":"node_gpu_utilization","target":{"type":"AverageValue","averageValue":"60"}}}]}}'`

armando-runtime: important: make sure metrics-server has accurate node-level GPU metric. i'm verifying. `kubectl get --raw /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1` -> shows `node_gpu_utilization` available. good.

sofia-sre: patched HPA, waiting for HPA controller to evaluate. `kubectl describe hpa inference-gpu -n inference` -> now shows external metric value ~72%, desired replicas bumped to 28. controller created scale event -> `Scaled up: inference-runtime from 12 to 20` (first step).

sofia-sre: prom pod is back and healthy. prom-adapter logs now show successful queries. HPA metrics should revert to primary after we validate.

lee-ml: prom memory pressure dropped after restart. query backlog clearing. we should watch for index growth due to high cardinality.

sofia-sre: monitoring note: queue length decreasing, throttling events down 80% in last 5m. p95 latency improved to ~5s. still elevated but recovering.

maya-support: updated customers with mitigation and ETA: "We've applied temporary scaling and restored core metrics. Many requests are being served again; we expect full recovery in ~30 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

armando-runtime: next steps for permanency: 1) revert the per-shard cardinality metric change (or rollup/label reduction), 2) add rate limits or relabeling at scrape time, 3) add resource autoscaling for prometheus, 4) add an adapter fallback policy in HPA that automatically switches metric source if adapter errors spike.

sofia-sre: agreed. i'm handing off to @armando-runtime for follow-up on the prometheus config and to @lee-ml for model-infra metric changes. i'll stay for the handoff window 15m.

armando-runtime: taking follow-up. will open an action-ticket and assign owners.

sofia-sre: final status for thread: impact mitigated, autoscaling restored via temporary HPA metric fallback, prometheus restarted and probing healthy, customers notified. closing incident channel in 30m unless regressions appear. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Incident recorded. Incident-ID: INC-20260314-1798765432. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-1798765432

maya-support: thx all, i'll send follow-up comms to affected accounts and draft a public status update if needed.

sofia-sre: handing off on-call to @sofia-sre (staying) -> actually i'm staying pinned for follow-up but not on primary pager. anyone else staying?

lee-ml: i'll monitor model infra metrics and put a patch to relabel high-cardinality labels into the queue.

armando-runtime: created ticket TKT-4821 "Prometheus high cardinality after model rollout" assigned to armando-runtime + lee-ml. ETA 72h.

sofia-sre: thanks everyone. closing thread in 30m, will update if anything else.
